headline: Public hearing on a two-lot subdivision at 20 Lenox Road, plus a workshop on zoning ordinance changes to match recent State law amendments.
summary: The main item is a public hearing on a two-lot subdivision at 20 Lenox Road, requested by 22 Lenox Avenue, LLC. The meeting also includes a workshop on proposed changes to the Town of Derry Zoning Ordinance.
items: Escrow #26-40, Hornes Pond Real Estate Grp.

Public hearing on 22 Lenox Avenue, LLC, PID 32039, 20 Lenox Road: acceptance and review of a two-lot subdivision
Workshop #2: proposed changes to the Town of Derry Zoning Ordinance to comply with recent State legislative amendments (postponed from Oct 07 and Nov 04)
